Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to subtract the corresponding values of two arrays of integers. 
Input Description:
The program should accept:
Two arrays of integers, arr1[] and arr2[], both of size n (where 1 ≤ n ≤ 1000).
The arrays will contain integer values. 
Output Description:
The program should print the resulting array where each element is the result of subtracting the corresponding elements from arr2[] from arr1[]. 
Sample Input:
3
5 7 9
2 4 6 
Sample Output:
3 3 3
